part5.name: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentences
part5.description: Chon tu thich hop de dien vao cho trong trong cau.

questions.text: I need you to finish those reports ------- next Thursday.
questions.hint: Han chot hoan thanh cong viec -> can gioi tu chi DEADLINE. Phan biet 'by' (truoc thoi diem) va 'until' (keo dai den thoi diem). Dong tu 'finish' la hanh dong hoan tat -> gioi tu nao?
questions.explanation: Gioi tu chi han chot 'khong muon hon': 'by next Thursday' = truoc thu Nam toi. 'until' chi khoang thoi gian keo dai, khong phu hop voi 'finish'. -> (B)

questions.text: Nowadays, ------- households in the developed world have at least one computer.
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc danh tu so nhieu 'households' -> loai 'every/each' (+ so it) va 'much' (+ khong dem duoc). Tu nao con lai?
questions.explanation: 'most households' = hau het cac ho gia dinh (danh tu so nhieu). 'every/each' + danh tu so it. 'much' + danh tu khong dem duoc. -> (A)

questions.text: The company hadn't experienced ------- high call volumes before and were ill-equipped to handle them all.
questions.hint: Can tu bo nghia cho 'high call volumes' (cum danh tu). Cau truc nao dung truoc ADJ + NOUN de nhan manh muc do?
questions.explanation: Cau truc 'such + adj + N' = nhu vay, den muc. 'such high call volumes' = luong cuoc goi cao den muc. -> (C)

questions.text: The Hoverton Commercial Committee ------- advertising and marketing methods in the region.
questions.hint: Chu ngu la 'Commercial Committee' (Uy ban Thuong mai) -> hanh dong cua uy ban doi voi 'advertising and marketing methods' la gi? Tu nao mang nghia 'dieu chinh/quan ly'?
questions.explanation: Uy ban Thuong mai dieu chinh (regulates) cac phuong phap quang cao va tiep thi. 'regulates' = kiem soat, dieu chinh. -> (D)

questions.text: This program is ------- harder to get accustomed to than the old one.
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc tinh tu so sanh hon 'harder'. Tu nao bo nghia duoc cho COMPARATIVE (so sanh hon)?
questions.explanation: 'much + comparative' = hon nhieu. 'much harder' = kho hon nhieu. 'very/so/such' khong dung truoc comparative. -> (D)

questions.text: When the manager arrived at the office, she was relieved to see that the technician ------- her computer.
questions.hint: Moc thoi gian qua khu 'arrived'. Hanh dong cua technician dang dien ra tai thoi diem manager den -> thi nao dien ta hanh dong DANG DIEN RA trong qua khu?
questions.explanation: Hai hanh dong xay ra dong thoi trong qua khu: manager arrived (QKD) va technician was fixing (QK tiep dien). -> (D)

questions.text: Many of the product samples brought for demonstration at the convention ------- on the plane ride.
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'product samples' la vat -> BI mat (khong tu mat). Can the bi dong. Thoi diem la qua khu (chuyen bay da xay ra) -> dang bi dong nao?
questions.explanation: Mau san pham BI mat (bi dong) tren chuyen bay -> 'were lost' (bi dong qua khu). -> (D)

questions.text: Even after the terrible fiscal year they had, there was still $1.5 million in -------.
questions.hint: O trong dung sau gioi tu 'in' va bo nghia cho '$1.5 million' -> can TU LOAI gi sau gioi tu?
questions.explanation: Sau gioi tu 'in' can danh tu: '$1.5 million in profits' = 1.5 trieu loi nhuan. -> (C)

questions.text: ------- this problem before, the maintenance technician knew exactly which tool to use to fix the appliance.
questions.hint: Menh de phan tu dien ta hanh dong xay ra TRUOC hanh dong chinh 'knew'. Chu ngu 'technician' la nguoi CHU DONG nhin thay -> dang phan tu nao?
questions.explanation: Phan tu hoan thanh 'Having seen' = Da thay truoc do -> nen biet dung dung cu. Chu ngu 'technician' chu dong nhin thay. -> (C)

questions.text: In addition to English, the vice-president can fluently ------- in both French and Spanish.
questions.hint: Dong tu di voi gioi tu 'in' + ngon ngu, mang nghia 'giao tiep/tro chuyen'. Phan biet: convene (trieu tap), convey (truyen dat), converse (tro chuyen), convert (chuyen doi).
questions.explanation: 'converse in' = tro chuyen bang (ngon ngu). Pho tong giam doc co the tro chuyen luu loat bang tieng Phap va Tay Ban Nha. -> (C)

questions.text: Though at first glance the products seem very much alike, they are ------- in many ways.
questions.hint: Cau co 'Though...alike' (du giong nhau) -> ve sau can tu TRAI NGHIA. Tu nao la tinh tu chi su KHAC BIET?
questions.explanation: 'seem alike' (giong nhau) tuong phan voi 'are different' (khac nhau). Tinh tu sau 'are' -> 'different'. -> (A)

questions.text: The law firm is looking for a new office building that is neither old ------- located outside of town.
questions.hint: Cau truc tuong quan bat dau bang 'neither' -> tu noi tiep theo la gi?
questions.explanation: Cau truc tuong quan: 'neither...nor...' = khong...cung khong. -> (B)

questions.text: Please do not cross the yellow line on the platform ------- the train has come to a complete stop.
questions.hint: Can lien tu chi thoi gian: 'dung lam gi CHO DEN KHI tau dung'. Tu nao mang nghia 'cho den khi'?
questions.explanation: 'until the train has come to a complete stop' = cho den khi tau dung han. Lien tu chi thoi gian. -> (B)

questions.text: Although Janet and Sam are both excellent managers, there are slight ------- in the way they do their jobs.
questions.hint: O trong dung sau tinh tu 'slight' -> can TU LOAI gi? 'variations' (bien the/khac biet), 'varieties' (cac loai), 'various' (da dang - adj), 'varies' (thay doi - verb).
questions.explanation: Sau tinh tu 'slight' can danh tu: 'slight variations' = nhung khac biet nho. -> (A)

questions.text: ------- business successfully internationally, we must learn the importance of respecting cultural differences.
questions.hint: Cum dau cau dien ta MUC DICH cua hanh dong 'must learn'. Cau truc nao dien ta muc dich?
questions.explanation: Cum muc dich 'To do business' = De kinh doanh thanh cong -> chung ta phai hoc. -> (A)

questions.text: If you require further -------, please feel free to contact us at 555-3333.
questions.hint: O trong dung sau 'further' (them) -> can TU LOAI gi? Danh tu nao trong 4 lua chon?
questions.explanation: Sau tinh tu 'further' can danh tu: 'further information' = them thong tin. -> (D)

questions.text: It has not rained for weeks, ------- my boss brings an umbrella to work every day.
questions.hint: Hai ve cau co noi dung TUONG PHAN: khong mua <-> van mang o. Tu noi nao dien ta su tuong phan/bat ngo?
questions.explanation: 'yet' = tuy nhien, nhung ma. Troi khong mua nhieu tuan NHUNG sep van mang o. Hai y tuong phan nhau. -> (A)

questions.text: The customer was not satisfied with the service and asked to talk to the manager -------.
questions.hint: Khach hang khong hai long -> yeu cau gap quan ly. Trang tu nao mang nghia 'ngay lap tuc, khong cham tre'?
questions.explanation: 'immediately' = ngay lap tuc. Khach hang khong hai long va yeu cau noi chuyen voi quan ly NGAY LAP TUC. -> (C)

questions.text: Most people who are elected to government positions come from ------- families.
questions.hint: Ô trống đứng trước danh từ 'families' → cần tính từ. Phân biệt nghĩa: 'respectable' (đáng kính trọng, gia thế danh giá) và 'respective' (tương ứng, riêng từng người). Nghĩa nào phù hợp để nói về xuất thân của các chính trị gia?
questions.explanation: Tính từ 'respectable' (đáng kính trọng, danh giá) bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'families'. Cụm 'respectable families' = các gia đình gia giáo/danh giá. 'respective' mang nghĩa là 'tương ứng', không phù hợp với ngữ cảnh này. → (C)

questions.text: This is the third time this week that each photocopier ------- broken down.
questions.hint: Cau truc dac biet: 'This is the third time (that) + S + ???'. Chu ngu 'each photocopier' la so it hay so nhieu?
questions.explanation: Cau truc 'This is the Nth time + S + has/have + V3'. 'each photocopier' la so it -> 'has'. -> (B)

questions.text: The electrical wires ------- by the terrible windstorm last night, leaving hundreds of customers without power.
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'electrical wires' la vat BI tac dong boi 'windstorm'. Thoi diem 'last night' -> thi nao, the chu dong hay bi dong?
questions.explanation: Day dien BI hu hai boi bao -> bi dong qua khu: 'were damaged'. Moc thoi gian 'last night'. -> (B)

questions.text: This was his fourth time taking his accounting certification exam, and he wanted ------- this time.
questions.hint: Cau truc: want + (not) + to V. Vi tri cua 'not' trong to-infinitive phu dinh nam o dau?
questions.explanation: 'wanted not to fail' = muon khong truot. Vi tri cua 'not' dung truoc 'to V'. -> (B)

questions.text: ------- the research uncovered some problems, the company decided to stop the project.
questions.hint: Hai ve cau co quan he NHAN-QUA: nghien cuu phat hien van de (NGUYEN NHAN) -> dung du an (KET QUA). Lien tu nao dien ta nguyen nhan?
questions.explanation: 'Since' = Vi/Boi vi. Nghien cuu phat hien van de -> QUYET DINH dung du an. Quan he nhan qua. -> (A)

questions.text: We need greater cooperation from everyone involved in order to meet the -------.
questions.hint: Cum dong tu 'meet the ___' la mot collocation pho bien trong TOEIC. Tu nao ket hop voi 'meet' mang nghia 'dat duoc/dap ung'?
questions.explanation: 'meet the deadline' = dat han chot. Cum tu co dinh trong kinh doanh. -> (A)

questions.text: With just a little more work, he ------- well-prepared for his sales presentation on Friday.
questions.hint: Cum 'with just a little more work' chi dieu kien CHUA xay ra -> ket qua se la gi? Thi nao dien ta ket qua TUONG LAI?
questions.explanation: Dieu kien tuong lai: 'with more work' -> 'he will be well-prepared'. Ket qua tuong lai. -> (A)

questions.text: Every time I need to use the photocopier, I find it needs -------.
questions.hint: Cau truc dac biet: 'need + V-ing' tuong duong 'need + to be + V3' (can duoc lam gi). May photocopy CAN DUOC sua -> dang nao?
questions.explanation: 'needs fixing' = can sua. Cau truc 'need + V-ing' (mang nghia bi dong). -> (C)

questions.text: Because of the partnership, Bob and Miles phone ------- several times a day.
questions.hint: Bob va Miles goi dien cho ___. Hai nguoi lam hanh dong TUONG HO (cho nhau). Dai tu tuong ho nao?
questions.explanation: 'phone each other' = goi dien cho NHAU. Bob va Miles goi dien cho nhau. -> (C)

questions.text: Let's take another ------- at the sales figures.
questions.hint: Cum dong tu 'take another ___ at': nhin lai. Tu nao ket hop voi 'take...at' thanh cum co dinh mang nghia 'xem qua'?
questions.explanation: 'take a glance at' = nhin luot qua. Cum dong tu co dinh. -> (C)

questions.text: It is reported that the boat ------- about 60 miles off the coast of South Africa last week.
questions.hint: 'disappear' la NOI dong tu (khong co tan ngu) -> KHONG dung bi dong. Moc thoi gian 'last week' -> thi nao?
questions.explanation: 'disappeared' (noi dong tu) -> khong dung bi dong. Moc thoi gian 'last week' -> qua khu don. -> (A)

questions.text: Since this is our slow season, I am considering ------- to vacation next month.
questions.hint: Dong tu 'consider' theo sau boi dang nao cua dong tu? V-ing hay to V?
questions.explanation: 'considering + V-ing' = dang can nhac lam gi. 'considering going' = dang can nhac di nghi. -> (B)

part6.name: Part 6 - Text Completion
part6.description: Doc doan van va dien tu thich hop vao cho trong.

questions.text: Complete blank 131 in the passage.
questions.hint: O trong noi hai cum danh tu: 'e-mail' va 'last week's airing'. Can tu mang nghia 'VE/LIEN QUAN DEN'. Tu nao vua la gioi tu vua phu hop?
questions.explanation: Gioi tu/phan tu 'regarding' = ve viec, lien quan den. 'regarding last week's airing' = ve buoi phat song tuan truoc. -> (C)

questions.text: Complete blank 132 in the passage.
questions.hint: Trang tu 'currently' chi thoi diem HIEN TAI va hanh dong DANG dien ra -> thi nao phu hop?
questions.explanation: 'currently' = hien tai -> thi hien tai tiep dien: 'is working'. Anh ay DANG lam viec de sua. -> (B)

questions.text: Complete blank 133 in the passage.
options: (C) We appreciate your help in fixing this error.
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau truoc noi ve viec sua loi, cau sau noi 'As such, we will be sending you gifts'. Can cau nao KET NOI giua viec sua loi va viec gui qua?
questions.explanation: Cau truoc noi ve viec sua loi dich thuat, cau sau gui qua cam on -> (C) cam on su giup do sua loi la cau noi tu nhien nhat. -> (C)

questions.text: Complete blank 134 in the passage.
questions.hint: Sau dai tu so huu 'our' can TU LOAI gi? Tu nao mang nghia 'long biet on/su cam kich'?
questions.explanation: 'gifts of our gratitude' = qua cam on/long biet on. Danh tu 'gratitude' sau 'our'. -> (A)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: Complete blank 135 in the passage.
questions.hint: Can gioi tu dung truoc cum danh tu 'the weeklong carnival' chi khoang thoi gian. 'While' + menh de, 'During' + cum danh tu.
questions.explanation: 'During + N' = trong suot. 'During the weeklong carnival' = trong suot le hoi keo dai mot tuan. -> (C)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: Complete blank 136 in the passage.
questions.hint: Dong tu 'was entered' la SO IT -> can tu chi so it. 'Each' + N so it, 'Most/All' + N so nhieu. 'Almost' la trang tu, khong dung truoc danh tu truc tiep.
questions.explanation: 'Each resident' = moi cu dan (so it). Dong tu 'was entered' la so it -> 'Each'. -> (A)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: Complete blank 137 in the passage.
options: (A) We were surprised by the results.
(B) The carnival is open from 9 to 5.
(C) We would like to congratulate all of our winners.
(D) If you do not accept your award, it will be given to the runner-up.
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau sau noi 'But we also want to mention a SPECIAL winner'. Can cau truoc noi ve CHUNG (tat ca nguoi thang) de tao su chuyen tiep.
questions.explanation: Truoc danh sach nguoi thang -> cau gioi thieu 'chuc mung tat ca nguoi thang cuoc' roi moi noi tiep 'nhung chung toi cung muon nhac den mot nguoi dac biet'. -> (C)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: Complete blank 138 in the passage.
questions.hint: Cum dau cau dien ta MUC DICH cua hanh dong 'please call'. Cau truc nao dien ta muc dich? To V hay V-ing?
questions.explanation: 'To claim your prize' = De nhan giai thuong cua ban -> vui long goi... Cum muc dich. -> (D)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: Complete blank 139 in the passage.
questions.hint: Cum co dinh 'It is with great ___ that we invite you'. Tu nao mang nghia 'niem vui/vinh du' phu hop voi van phong trang trong?
questions.explanation: 'It is with great pleasure that...' = Chung toi rat vui duoc moi... Cum co dinh trong thu moi trang trong. -> (C)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: Complete blank 140 in the passage.
questions.hint: Su kien la TUONG LAI (dang moi tham du). Dong tu can chia o thi nao? Chu ngu 'The event' la chu dong hay bi dong voi 'feature'?
questions.explanation: Su kien TUONG LAI (chua dien ra, dang moi) -> 'will feature' = se co. -> (A)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: Complete blank 141 in the passage.
options: (A) We ask that each person who attends the dinner give a donation of $50 or more to the organization.
(B) Families with children under the age of 10 are asked to leave their children at home.
(C) Those with special dietary restrictions are asked to mention their preference on their RSVP.
(D) Dinner will be held on the outdoor terrace beginning at 8 p.m.
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: Đọc câu tiếp theo có cụm 'The proceeds from this...' (Khoản tiền thu từ việc này...). Đại từ 'this' và 'proceeds' liên kết trực tiếp với khoản quyên góp nào ở câu trước?
questions.explanation: Câu tiếp theo nêu: 'The proceeds from this will go toward the library expansion project' (Khoản thu từ việc này sẽ dành cho dự án mở rộng thư viện). Cụm 'The proceeds from this' liên kết trực tiếp với khoản đóng góp quyên góp 'a donation of $50 or more' ở câu (A). → (A)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: Complete blank 142 in the passage.
questions.hint: Tinh tu bo nghia cho 'evening' trong ngu canh THU MOI su kien. Tu nao dien ta buoi toi DAC BIET, DANG NHO?
questions.explanation: 'an unforgettable evening' = buoi toi kho quen. Phu hop voi thu moi trang trong. -> (C)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: Complete blank 143 in the passage.
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'we' (chung toi) -> noi ve khach hang cua AI? Can tinh tu so huu tuong ung voi 'we'.
questions.explanation: Tinh tu so huu 'our customers' = khach hang CUA CHUNG TOI. Save Mart noi ve khach hang cua minh. -> (D)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: Complete blank 144 in the passage.
questions.hint: Can phu dinh dong tu 'is'. Tu phu dinh nao dung sau 'is' trong cau truc 'is ___ valid'?
questions.explanation: 'is not valid' = khong co hieu luc. Phu dinh dong tu 'is' bang 'not'. -> (B)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: Complete blank 145 in the passage.
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc tinh tu so sanh hon 'better'. Tu nao bo nghia cho COMPARATIVE de nhan manh?
questions.explanation: 'much better' = tot hon nhieu. 'much' bo nghia cho so sanh hon 'better'. -> (B)

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: Complete blank 146 in the passage.
options: (A) The more you buy, the more you save.
(C) Selections may vary from store to store.
(D) Please see the manager to sign up for our membership program.
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau sau noi san pham co the khong co san. Can cau nao LIEN QUAN den tinh kha dung/su khac biet giua cac cua hang?
questions.explanation: Cau sau noi 'items may not be available' -> (C) 'Selections may vary from store to store' cung noi ve tinh kha dung cua san pham, tao chuyen tiep tu nhien. -> (C)

part7.name: Part 7 - Reading Comprehension
part7.description: Doc cac doan van va tra loi cau hoi lien quan.

questions.text: What is NOT stated about the retiring CEO?
options: (A) He will remain on the board of directors.
(B) He has held several jobs at the company.
(C) He has been with Ventura for 20 years.
(D) He focused on creating new products as CEO.
questions.hint: Cau hoi NOT: 3 dap an DUNG trong bai. Tim dap an KHONG duoc nhac den ve retiring CEO (Paolo Lucas). Ai la '20-year veteran'?
questions.explanation: Lucas served on the board since 2004, appointed president 2008, CEO 2009. Khong noi 20 nam. Manuel Garza moi la '20-year veteran'. -> (C)

questions.text: The word 'effective' in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.hint: Tu 'effective' trong ngu canh 'effective on October 31' mang nghia gi? Khong phai 'hieu qua' ma la 'CO HIEU LUC tu ngay...'.
questions.explanation: 'effective on October 31' = co hieu luc/bat dau tu ngay 31/10. 'operative' = co hieu luc, hoat dong. -> (B)

questions.text: What is suggested about Ellen B?
options: (A) She is willing to miss the CFO visit.
(C) She did not receive an e-mail.
questions.hint: Tim thong tin ve Ellen B. Meryl nhac den 'vegetarian options for you, too' -> dieu nay goi y gi ve Ellen?
questions.explanation: Meryl noi 'lots of vegetarian options for you, too' -> Ellen an chay = khong an thit. -> (D)

questions.text: At 11:48, what does Ellen B mean when she writes, 'Thai food it is, then'?
options: (A) She wants to try the restaurant another time.
(B) She will go to the restaurant for lunch.
(C) She wants to know more about Thai food.
questions.hint: Cum 'Thai food it is, then' la cach noi DONG Y. Truoc do Meryl da giai quyet van de gio giac (CFO visit da doi). Ellen dang xac nhan dieu gi?
questions.explanation: Ellen dong y di an Thai: 'Thai food it is, then' = Vay thi an Thai nhe. Co ay se di nha hang an trua. -> (B)

questions.text: How much has Vista Hotel already paid?
questions.hint: Tim trong hoa don muc 'Payments' - so tien da thanh toan. Balance = so tien con no.
questions.explanation: Hoa don ghi: Payments: -2,000.00. Balance: 1,937.01. Vay da thanh toan $2,000. -> (C)

questions.text: Which is true about Mint Design?
options: (B) It charges a set price per project.
(C) It does not specify a payment method.
(D) It does not charge late fees.
questions.hint: Doc ky hoa don: cot 'Unit' ghi gi? 'payable by check only' ghi o dau? 'Late payments' co bi tinh phi khong?
questions.explanation: Hoa don ghi: 'Design services (logo, letterhead, business card) - $3,500.00 - project - Qty 1'. Tinh gia theo du an. -> (B). Hoa don cung ghi 'payable by check only' -> co chi dinh phuong thuc. 'Late payments subject to 5% charges' -> co tinh phi tre han.

questions.text: Why is Randy selling his car?
questions.hint: Tim ly do ban xe trong doan dau. 'transferring me overseas' nghia la gi?
questions.explanation: 'my company is transferring me overseas' = cong ty chuyen toi ra nuoc ngoai. -> (D)

questions.text: What is stated about the car?
options: (D) It has a new coat of paint.
questions.hint: Doc danh sach dac diem xe. Tu 'original' xuat hien o dau? 'New exhaust, shocks, tires' -> tires da MOI hay can moi?
questions.explanation: 'Classic F-platform with original doors and GM/Delco stereo!' -> co stereo GOC (original). -> (B). Tires da duoc thay moi, seat covers included, needs paint touch-up.

questions.text: Where is Mr. Brown now?
questions.hint: Mr. Brown viet email ngay 15/8, noi 'leaving Concord early tomorrow morning'. Vay hien tai anh ay dang o dau?
questions.explanation: Email: 'I will now be leaving Concord early tomorrow morning' -> hien tai van o Concord. -> (D)

questions.text: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? 'My flight to California has been canceled because of bad weather.'
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: Đọc ngữ cảnh các vị trí [1], [2], [3], [4]. Câu 'My flight to California has been canceled because of bad weather' giải thích lý do cho việc hoãn và đổi lịch trình, vị trí nào kết nối tự nhiên nhất trước khi đưa ra thông tin chuyến bay mới?
questions.explanation: Câu 'My flight to California has been canceled because of bad weather' giải thích lý do tại sao chuyến bay bị hủy và cần dời lịch hẹn, phù hợp đặt tại vị trí [2] trước khi chuyển sang chi tiết thời gian đến mới. → (B)

questions.text: When will Mr. Brown arrive?
questions.hint: Email viet ngay August 15. 'leaving tomorrow morning' va 'arriving tomorrow night'. 'Tomorrow' la ngay nao?
questions.explanation: Email ngay 15/8: 'leaving Concord early tomorrow morning' = sang 16/8, 'arriving in Los Angeles...tomorrow night around 8:00' = toi 16/8. -> (C)

questions.text: On what day are two movies shown?
questions.hint: Doc lich chieu cua tung phim. Ngay nao co HAI phim cung chieu?
questions.explanation: Friday: 'Elvis and the Swamp Monster' (Thu-Fri, 8:00 p.m.) + 'Digstown' (Fri-Sun, 9:00 p.m., 12:00 a.m.). Hai phim chieu ngay Friday. -> (D)

questions.text: How will the theater choose the theme of the next special feature week?
questions.hint: Tim cau noi ve cach chon chu de tiep theo. 'audience choice form' va 'results of the survey' goi y dieu gi?

questions.text: What will Olivia Benn do this week?
options: (B) Give a presentation to the marketing department
(C) Work on ideas for marketing trips to young people
(D) Think of ways to market Spanish vacations
questions.hint: Doc email cua Olivia Benn. Co ay tu phan cong minh lam target nao? Target A va B la gi?
questions.explanation: Email: 'Greg and I will work on target A. Nigel and Yasmin, I'd like you to tackle target B.' -> Olivia (+ Greg) lam target A = tang khach lon di Tay Ban Nha. Nhung cau hoi hoi Olivia lam gi -> (C) la phu hop vi target B la young visitors traveling within Britain, va Olivia phan cong cho Nigel+Yasmin. Olivia lam target A. Tuy nhien doc ky: Target A = increase older customers visiting Spain, Target B = increase younger visitors traveling within Britain. Olivia + Greg lam Target A -> (D) nghien cuu tiep thi cho du lich Tay Ban Nha. Nhung (D) noi 'market Spanish vacations' chi la mot phan. Xem lai: Olivia Benn lam gi 'this week'? Email noi 'Let's meet as teams tomorrow at 4:30 and start brainstorming. Then on Friday, each team will make a presentation.' -> tuan nay Olivia se brainstorm + present ve target A (older customers -> Spain). (C) noi 'marketing trips to young people' la target B (Nigel+Yasmin lam). (D) 'market Spanish vacations' = target A (Olivia lam). -> (D) chinh xac hon.

questions.text: What might the HR department win in November?
questions.hint: Doc Email. Phan thuong hang thang cho bo phan tai che tot nhat la gi? 'catered pizza party' la gi?
questions.explanation: Email: 'if your department succeeds in producing the least wastage for three months in a row, each member will receive a $50 bonus.' + 'you will therefore be enjoying delicious free pizza next week'. HR da thang thang 9 -> neu thang tiep 3 thang lien tiep (9,10,11) -> $50 bonus. Nhung cau hoi hoi 'win in November' -> catered pizza party cho thang thang tiep. Doc ky: pizza la phan thuong cho thang THANG 9. Thang 10, 11 neu thang tiep -> $50 bonus. -> (A). Nhung xem ky: 'catered pizza party will be awarded to the department that wastes the least paper during the month of September' -> pizza la cho thang 9. Neu HR thang thang 10 -> lai duoc pizza. Thang 11 cung vay. -> (B) Free food (pizza). -> (B)
